# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 4, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on August 4, 2026, focused on stabilizing core infrastructure, improving Discord and voice session reliability, and refining the LifeOps scheduling system. Significant progress was made in CI/CD hardening, dependency management, and resolving cross-platform verification issues.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**LifeOps and Scheduling Improvements**
*   Bound scheduled task outputs to canonical server-attested DMs rather than model-supplied parameters ([#17646](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17646)).
*   Ensured internal rooms are excluded from connector dispatch to prevent routing errors ([#17676](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17676)).

**Discord and Voice Reliability**
*   Implemented readiness checks to prevent ingress before Discord identity hydration ([#17645](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17645)).
*   Fixed false-positive diagnostic secrets in Discord services ([#17671](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17671)).
*   Ensured interrupted voice turns are correctly persisted on the canonical Durable Object path ([#17644](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17644)).

**CI/CD and Infrastructure Hardening**
*   Registered Hetzner routing audits to improve CI reliability ([#17655](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17655)).
*   Updated contributor tooling to support GitHub CLI 2.45 inventory pagination ([#17675](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17675)).
*   Performed extensive dependency updates across the workspace, including `undici`, `wrangler`, and various GitHub Actions ([#17650](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17650), [#17705](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17705), [#17702](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17702)).

*   **UI/UX Contracts:** [#17374](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17374) (Chat-sheet transcription privacy-stop contract aligned).

## NEW ISSUES

## ACTIVE ISSUES
*   **[#15973](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/15973) (PII Scrubbing):** Discussion continues on separating entity resolution from PII redaction. Contributors suggest using a local policy API (e.g., Flare Redact) to handle semantic detection and redaction, ensuring stable pseudonymization across different aliases.
*   **[#17044](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17044) (Bun Runtime Unification):** Ongoing effort to unify Bun versions across the repository. The current focus is on replacing mutable `canary` references with exact versions (1.3.14) and updating CI workflows to use a single source of truth for runtime declarations.
*   **[#17268](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17268) (Windows/UI Verification):** Work is underway to repair five specific verification contracts, including Windows-safe path detection and native Gateway SwiftLint invocation, to ensure cross-platform stability.
